entry.content: Navigation in Flutter is a constant string of compromises. At first it looks simple: push and pop. Navigator 1.0 is simple and predictable, but it falls apart at scale. Navigator 2.0 gives you full control, but the amount of boilerplate is so painful you might as well roll your own framework.
